8/19.04.2023
On repeated call nobody has responded on behalf of the  petitioners.

This petition has been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 30.11.2013 in G.R. No.260 of 2013 (Jadugora P.S.Case No.33 of 2013), pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ghatshila.

Status report is on the record which suggest that the custody accused Madhu Das was pleaded his guilt and sentence to undergo S.I. of two years four months and sixteen days for an offence u/s 498A of the IPC and SI of two years four months sixteen days for an offence u/s 3/ 4 of the D.P. Act with fine of Rs.1000/- each and in default of payment of fine SI of fifteen days has been sentenced and all the sentences will run concurrently except the SI of fifteen days in the default of payment of fine.
Accused Anil Das was declared absconder and the rest are also absconder.
Nobody has come forwarded to argue this matter.
